rule: Select one primary packet. Actual proof dependencies and status require original evidence; upstream lists are advisory. Review nominees recuse if contributors.

assignments.target_statement: Attack the existential inequality B_i(f)<=K I_i(f) for some relevant i. Use the exact entropy decrement identity and distinguish a genuine coordinate-selection theorem from an all-coordinate claim.

deliverables.description: GOOD_COORDINATE_TARGET.tex: exact selection rule and proposed universal or restricted theorem
SELECTION_SCOPE.md: tested controls, first open line, and FEI implication

acceptance_criteria: For each nonconstant function select a coordinate with I_i>0 and prove B_i≤K I_i with one stated K, or explicitly restrict the class.
Use the exact mismatch/KL rebate and recovered mechanism lower-bound controls; do not restart a known-false all-coordinate or K=4 erasure claim.
If a universal selection theorem is obtained, give the full physical induction and constant K+2/ln2; otherwise keep that universal target unproved.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A new selection inequality for a named class, or a proved obstruction to the precise selection rule, supports another pilot.

assignments.target_statement: Use the recovered exact block identity B_W=Σ_T R_T H(ν_T), M_W=a−Σ_T R_T H(r_T), Δ_WH=B_W+M_W, with the mixing term controlled by queried influence. Seek a proved adaptive proper-block or stopping-tree selection theorem paying the remaining conditional entropy. The choice W=[n] leaves the full entropy H(f) and is not a reduction.

deliverables.description: ADAPTIVE_BLOCK_SELECTION.tex: block rule, influence loss, and conditional charge
BLOCK_CONTROLS.md: plateau, bent-splice, and proper-block comparisons

acceptance_criteria: Start with B_W=Σ_T R_T H(ν_T) and 0≤M_W≤(2/ln2)I_W; define I_W as the total queried influence under the appropriate block telescope.
Prove a structural rule selecting proper/adaptive blocks or paying a complete tree; selecting W=[n] leaves B_W=H(f) and is not a simplification.
State every physical conditioning law and show a quantified benefit on a coded plateau while retaining the bent-splice obstruction.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A nontrivial proper-block selection/payment theorem or a rigorous failure of the proposed rule is delivered.

assignments.target_statement: Design trees stopping at the recovered regular, bounded-overlap, or threshold-formula classes. Prove the full expected path cost plus terminal cost is at most a fixed multiple of root influence.

deliverables.description: TERMINAL_CLASS_STOPPING.tex: physical tree and terminal membership proof
PATH_AND_LEAF_PAYMENT.md: expected cost plus terminal entropy

acceptance_criteria: Prove that every leaf belongs to a published terminal class with uniformly controlled class parameters; calling a leaf a threshold/formula is insufficient without membership.
Bound the complete weighted path sum and terminal H together, and identify the single root influence budget from which both are paid.
Treat any assertion that all Boolean functions cheaply reach those leaves as the new theorem to prove, never an assumed representation premise.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A fully paid stopping theorem on an unbounded family, or a quantified hitting-cost obstruction, is the required next increment.

assignments.target_statement: Keep the actual deficits of both physical children in an induction. Derive conditions under which a difficult split is compensated by child slack, and test that the slack is not counted repeatedly.

deliverables.description: SLACK_FLOW.json: parent/child accounting with no duplicate credits

acceptance_criteria: Derive D_K(f)=average D_K(children)+K I_i(f)−Δ_iH(f) using the actual two children and all signs/means.
State when child nonnegativity is an induction hypothesis, a proved terminal fact, or still open; zero child slack cannot be assumed.
Show that one child's slack is not spent once at its parent and again at a descendant; hand the finite-tree transport interface to A064.
assignments.renewal_milestone: A correct compensated split lemma with a proved application, or an exact counterexample to its proposed slack rule.

assignments.target_statement: Use separated Fourier-support coding to create functions with long entropy-preserving restriction plateaux. Determine what a global selection or stopping argument sees that bounded-depth local statistics miss.

deliverables.description: RESTRICTION_PLATEAUX.tex: explicit coded Boolean family and persistence depth
PLATEAU_SELECTION_DIAGNOSTIC.md: what each proposed local/block rule observes

acceptance_criteria: Prove entropy preservation or its stated quantitative error for every restriction in the declared bounded-depth regime.
Give the actual truth-table/circuit construction and track added influence from the auxiliary code.
Distinguish an obstruction to a bounded-depth statistic from an obstruction to all global coordinate or block choices.
assignments.renewal_milestone: One reusable parameterized plateau control isolates a concrete weakness of a live selection rule.
